name: codex-security
description: OpenAI's Codex Security CLI and TypeScript SDK for finding, validating, and fixing security vulnerabilities. npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@openai/codex-security
one_liner: A tool that scans your codebase for security holes, checks whether each one is real (not a false alarm), and can write the fix for you — like having a junior security auditor on call 24/7.
buyer: A security-conscious engineering lead at a 10-50 person startup that can't afford a dedicated AppSec hire.
business_use_cases: A startup runs it in CI on every pull request so vulnerabilities get caught and auto-patched before merge instead of in a yearly pentest.
A boutique security consultancy uses it to triage findings fast across many client repos, cutting the hours billed per audit.
A compliance-heavy company (fintech, healthtech) exports its SARIF/CSV reports as evidence for SOC2 or ISO audits.

money_ideas.idea: Build a hosted dashboard on top of the open CLI/SDK that non-technical compliance teams can read, and charge per repo scanned
Offer paid 'scan and fix' sprints for companies that want a one-time cleanup rather than ongoing monitoring

steal_this: Build a GitHub Action marketplace wrapper that runs this on every PR and posts a plain-English summary comment ('3 issues found, 1 fixed automatically') — free for public repos, paid for private ones.
